mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.BRANCH_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID, TS.GOVT_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TN.CARID_NO, TN.CAR_NO, TN.OWNER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID WHERE TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TS.PROC_ST = 'W_REQ'
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SERVICE SET PROC_ST = 'S_REQ', JUDGE_ST = 'S_REQ', UPD_DATE = SYSDATE, UPD_USER = 'SCHEDULAR' WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND PROC_ST = 'W_REQ'
